categories.name: Adult content
categories.definition: Domains whose primary purpose, or a substantial recurring offering, is pornography, sexually explicit material intended for arousal, explicit sexual performances, or access to those services.
categories.yes: Pornographic video libraries; explicit webcam services; explicit sexual image communities.
categories.no: Non-explicit matchmaking; sexual-health education; medical anatomy; ordinary nudity; non-explicit romantic content; ordinary fashion or swimwear shops.
categories.rules: Classification relies on objective evidence, such as explicit sexual acts, pornographic video libraries, or explicit sexual performances. Ordinary nudity, anatomy, medical material, and non-explicit romantic content are not automatically classified. Sexual context alone is insufficient. Non-explicit romance belongs to Dating. Explicit dating services can match both. A broad platform with substantial inseparable explicit material may also match Mixed content; one explicit post does not classify the domain.

categories.name: Gambling
categories.definition: Domains materially offering or facilitating wagers of money or redeemable value on uncertain outcomes, including casino play, sports betting, lotteries, and paid chance-based prizes.
categories.yes: Online casinos; sportsbooks; paid lottery ticket services; cash-out skin betting.
categories.no: Sports scores; investing without wagering; free games with no stakes or redeemable prizes; gambling-addiction support.
categories.rules: Licensing does not remove membership. Free demos on a real-money gambling service remain part of that domain. Purely educational probability material is excluded. Paid fantasy contests qualify when entry stakes fund outcome-dependent prizes. Games with incidental loot boxes need evidence of qualifying wagering, not assumption.

categories.name: Drugs & vaping
categories.definition: One switch covering two parts: domains materially selling, sourcing, promoting, or facilitating the use of recreational intoxicating drugs, and domains materially selling, sourcing, promoting, or facilitating the use of vaping devices or e-liquids, with or without nicotine.
categories.yes: Recreational cannabis shops; drug-sourcing marketplaces; vape retailers; nicotine-free e-liquid shops.
categories.no: General pharmacies; medical research; factual reporting; addiction treatment; harm-reduction education; non-promotional public-health information.
categories.rules: Discussion of vaping, cannabis, or recreational drugs does not qualify by itself; the domain must materially sell, source, promote, or facilitate use. Factual reporting, research, public-health education, and harm reduction remain excluded. Legality alone does not exclude recreational drugs or vaping. Dedicated medical-cannabis sellers qualify as a stated policy choice; general clinical information does not. Alcohol, combustible tobacco, and ordinary medicines are not automatically added to this combined switch. Add Shopping & food for qualifying sellers.

categories.name: Dating
categories.definition: Domains built primarily, or with a substantial standalone service, to find romantic or sexual partners through profiles, matching, introductions, or arranged dates.
categories.yes: Matchmaking services; marriage-introduction services; dating apps; hookup platforms.
categories.no: General messaging; friendship-only communities; marriage counseling; wedding planning; a social network merely used to flirt.
categories.rules: Dating does not require nudity or explicit material. Religious matchmaking still qualifies by function. Add Adult content only when its separate explicit-content test is met. Incidental dating discussion on a general forum does not classify the whole forum.

categories.name: Mixed content
categories.definition: Domains with substantial, recurring combinations of otherwise allowed material and material matching one or more of the other 10 Adult & unsafe categories, where those offerings cannot reliably be separated at the supported domain or hostname boundary.
categories.yes: A broad user-content community with substantial inseparable explicit sections; a mixed media host repeatedly carrying substantial qualifying restricted material.
categories.no: A general site with one bad post; an unknown site; a news outlet reporting on restricted topics; a platform merely offering several neutral features.
categories.rules: Record the restricted category, representative domain-wide evidence, and why separation fails. This is not a catch-all for uncertainty or all social media. Restricted here means an Adult & unsafe category, not whichever top-level switch happens to be ON. Also assign every directly supported category; Mixed content is independent.

categories.name: Violence/weapons/hate
categories.definition: Domains materially promoting, celebrating, or facilitating real-world violence or group-targeted hatred; distributing graphic real-world gore for shock; or specializing in weapons sales, manufacture, or operational use.
categories.yes: Hate-propaganda hubs; gore galleries; weapon retailers; bomb-making instruction services.
categories.no: General news; anti-hate education; museums; emergency care; martial-arts fitness; kitchen-tool shops; fictional combat games by themselves.
categories.rules: Weapons coverage includes lawful firearms retailers and specialist sport-weapon services as a policy choice, not a claim of criminality. Criticism of an idea is not automatically hate. Documentary or safety context is excluded unless harmful promotion is a substantial offering. Combat games belong to Gaming unless another test independently applies.

categories.name: Piracy & torrents
categories.definition: Domains materially distributing, indexing, or facilitating unauthorized copyrighted media, cracked software, license bypasses, or torrent/magnet discovery and distribution as a core service.
categories.yes: Pirated-film indexes; cracked-software repositories; torrent search services; dedicated torrent-client distribution sites.
categories.no: Licensed streaming; lawful direct software downloads; an ordinary software download site offering a torrent client among many unrelated products; an ordinary cloud drive merely capable of hosting infringements.
categories.rules: The torrent portion includes legitimate torrent-only services as a stated policy choice; the category name must not imply all torrents are piracy. Open-source torrent distribution qualifies when torrent distribution is the domain’s core service, not an incidental download option. Dedicated torrent-client distribution websites qualify because this category intentionally covers torrent technology, even when the software is used legally. An ordinary software download website does not qualify simply because it offers a torrent client among many unrelated products. Add Hacking & cheating tools for cracks that independently meet that definition.

categories.name: Malware & phishing
categories.definition: Domains demonstrably serving malicious payloads, credential theft, deceptive impersonation, unauthorized surveillance, exploit delivery, or command-and-control infrastructure.
categories.yes: Verified credential-harvesting sites; ransomware delivery hosts; active botnet control hosts; covert spyware distribution.
categories.no: Legitimate VPNs; antivirus vendors; authorized remote support; security research; unknown or newly registered domains without evidence.
categories.rules: Require current credible threat evidence. A hacked page is not enough to label a shared parent domain; use an isolatable hostname or queue review where the filter cannot isolate it. Recheck stale threat labels after remediation. Encryption, anonymity, or remote control alone is not maliciousness.

categories.name: Anonymous chat & random video chat
categories.definition: Domains whose core or substantial service connects strangers through random, roulette-style, anonymous, or low-identity chat, including video matching and anonymous stranger chat rooms.
categories.yes: Random stranger video matchers; anonymous text roulette; anonymous stranger-chat communities.
categories.no: Private family calls; scheduled business meetings; pseudonymous forums without stranger-chat matching; ordinary contacts-based messaging.
categories.rules: A temporary nickname does not by itself qualify. Look for stranger discovery or anonymous conversational access as a central feature. Add Messaging & chat apps when real-time chat is substantial; add Dating or Adult content only on separate evidence.

categories.name: Self-harm & eating disorders
categories.definition: Domains materially encouraging, glorifying, coaching, or organizing self-injury, suicide, or disordered eating, including harmful concealment and competitive restriction communities.
categories.yes: Pro-suicide communities; self-injury instruction hubs; pro-anorexia coaching services.
categories.no: Crisis support; recovery communities; clinical information; responsible reporting; ordinary nutrition or fitness services.
categories.rules: Discussion of distress, a diagnosis, or recovery does not qualify by itself. Distinguish prevention and harm reduction from encouragement. A mixed community needs evidence of a substantial harmful offering, not one vulnerable person’s post; use Mixed content where its separate test applies.

categories.name: Hacking & cheating tools
categories.definition: Domains materially providing or promoting unauthorized intrusion, credential attacks, service disruption, security or license circumvention, competitive game cheats, or services for academic dishonesty, including exam impersonation, stolen answer distribution, plagiarism-facilitation services such as essay mills, paid assignment-writing services, services selling completed academic work, and services that help users conceal or submit plagiarized work dishonestly, proctoring circumvention, and services marketed to complete academic assessments dishonestly.
categories.yes: Credential-theft kits; attack-for-hire services; game cheat marketplaces; exam impersonation; stolen answer distribution; plagiarism-facilitation services such as essay mills and paid assignment-writing services; proctoring circumvention.
categories.no: Antivirus; authorized penetration testing; defensive research; capture-the-flag labs; tutoring; proofreading; ordinary writing assistance; educational AI tools that do not specifically offer cheating services; accessibility tools; permitted game mods; legitimate plagiarism detection, similarity checking, citation checking, and academic integrity software.
categories.rules: Judge the service’s marketed purpose and recurring offering, not tool power alone. Dual-use scanners and exploit research do not qualify without substantial abuse-oriented positioning. Tutoring, proofreading, ordinary writing assistance, and educational AI tools are excluded unless they specifically offer cheating services. Malware & phishing requires actual malicious infrastructure or payload evidence. VPNs alone belong to their own switch, not this one. Plagiarism-facilitation services qualify; legitimate plagiarism detection, similarity checking, citation checking, and academic integrity software do not.

categories.name: Messaging & chat apps
categories.definition: Domains primarily providing, distributing, or operating real-time person-to-person or group communication through text, voice, or video, including workplace chat and meeting services.
categories.yes: WhatsApp-style private messaging; team chat; group messaging; video meeting services.
categories.no: Email-only services; article comment boxes; customer-support widgets on otherwise unrelated sites; AI-only conversations.
categories.rules: Social media needs a substantial public or audience-based publishing/community function, not just private messages. Assign both when both are substantial. Stranger matching also gets Anonymous chat & random video chat. File attachments do not automatically make messaging a cloud-storage service.

categories.name: Web mail
categories.definition: Domains or separable service hostnames whose core function is browser-based email: mailboxes, sending, receiving, reading, or managing email, including disposable inbox services.
categories.yes: Consumer webmail; hosted business inboxes; temporary web inboxes.
categories.no: A shop’s contact form; email newsletters as articles; mail-security documentation; an account sign-in host used by many products.
categories.rules: Do not label an entire multi-product provider Web mail because it owns one inbox service. Target the mail hostname where supported. Email with incidental chat remains Web mail; add Messaging & chat apps when chat is a substantial separate offering. Privacy-focused mail is not a VPN by default.

categories.name: VPNs, proxies & filter bypass
categories.definition: Domains materially providing, distributing, or operating VPNs, anonymizing proxies, web proxies, tunneling, or services explicitly intended to route around network filtering.
categories.yes: Commercial privacy VPNs; proxy gateways; browser-based unblockers; circumvention tunnel services.
categories.no: Antivirus; encrypted banking; ordinary HTTPS sites; general DNS documentation; privacy advice without a routing service.
categories.rules: Legitimate privacy and business VPNs qualify by function, not maliciousness. Add Malware & phishing only on separate threat evidence. A general resolver or encrypted DNS service is not automatically bypass: include it only when bypass routing is a material marketed function. Short links and translation services are not automatically proxies.

categories.name: Social media
categories.definition: Domains with a primary or substantial service for user profiles, public or audience-based posting, feeds, sharing, following, or community discussion.
categories.yes: Social feeds; public discussion networks; creator communities; image-sharing networks.
categories.no: Private chat alone; a shop with reviews; a news site’s incidental comments; a company brochure with social buttons.
categories.rules: Forums qualify when ongoing user-to-user community publishing is a core service. Add Messaging & chat apps for substantial direct chat, and Video streaming or Live streaming when those are substantial services. Do not assign Mixed content merely because user-generated content exists.

categories.name: Video streaming
categories.definition: Domains whose primary or substantial function is delivering on-demand prerecorded video for viewing, including film/TV catalogs, video-sharing services, and dedicated video-learning libraries.
categories.yes: On-demand film libraries; YouTube-style video sharing; dedicated prerecorded lecture-video services.
categories.no: A text news site with occasional clips; video-call-only services; a live-only broadcast platform; download-only files without a video-viewing service.
categories.rules: On-demand video is the key distinction from Live streaming. If both are substantial, assign both. Replay catalogs qualify even when the originals were live. A social feed with substantial video viewing can match Social media too. Educational purpose does not erase video membership.

categories.name: Gaming
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially offering playable games, game distribution, cloud gaming, game accounts/servers, or dedicated gaming communities and guides.
categories.yes: Browser-game portals; game storefronts; cloud-game services; dedicated game guide communities.
categories.no: General programming lessons; a retailer with a small game aisle; sports scores; video-only game broadcasts without a substantial gaming service or dedicated gaming community.
categories.rules: Educational games and chess qualify by function. Money wagering adds Gambling when that test is met. A general live-video platform is not Gaming merely because some streams show games. Cheats add Hacking & cheating tools only when independently supported.

categories.name: Music & podcasts
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially offering music or podcast listening, distribution, discovery, or dedicated catalogs, including internet radio and spoken-word podcast services.
categories.yes: Music streaming; podcast directories and listening services; dedicated online radio; music-download stores.
categories.no: A general site with one embedded song; private voice messaging; a news site with an incidental audio clip.
categories.rules: Dedicated podcast services qualify regardless of topic. A broad news domain with only an occasional podcast does not. Music-video platforms may also match Video streaming; substantial live audio broadcasting can also match Live streaming. Artist merchandise shops alone belong to Shopping & food.

categories.name: Shopping & food
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially supporting consumer purchases, retail marketplaces, groceries, prepared-food ordering, meal delivery, or restaurant menu and reservation services.
categories.yes: Online stores; grocery ordering; food delivery; restaurant ordering and reservation services.
categories.no: Noncommercial recipe education; product safety notices; a charity donation page; a normal service’s incidental subscription checkout.
categories.rules: Include restaurant sites centered on menus, dining, and bookings even without online payment. A specialist merchant can also match Drugs & vaping or Violence/weapons/hate. Do not add every paid software, media, or professional-service domain merely because it has a Buy button.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Domains whose primary or substantial editorial service is regularly reporting or aggregating current events, including local, national, international, business, and specialist news.
categories.yes: Newspapers; news broadcasters; current-affairs aggregators; dedicated industry news outlets.
categories.no: Static encyclopedias; company press-release pages; personal journals without a news service; one current-events article on another kind of site.
categories.rules: Classify by reporting function, not political viewpoint, trustworthiness, or whether the news is upsetting. Financial news can also match Crypto & investing and sports news can match Sports. Reporting on violence, drugs, or self-harm is not promotion of those topics.

categories.name: AI & chatbots
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially offering public-facing AI assistants, conversational AI, companion bots, or interfaces where users interact directly with an AI system for responses or generated content.
categories.yes: General AI assistants; conversational search assistants; role-play bots; public generative-AI interfaces.
categories.no: A store with a small support bot; articles about AI; an ordinary site using AI behind the scenes; a developer documentation site without a public AI interaction service.
categories.rules: Include text, voice, image, and multimodal assistant interfaces. Human-to-human messaging is not AI chat. A bot platform with substantial explicit sexual offerings can also match Adult content. Do not classify a whole cloud provider because one product is an AI assistant.

categories.name: Sports
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially covering, organizing, or delivering competitive sports, teams, leagues, scores, fixtures, sporting events, or fantasy-sports participation.
categories.yes: League and team sites; score services; sports news; fantasy-league services.
categories.no: General wellness advice; a gym’s fitness classes; non-sport outdoor travel; a general news site’s incidental sports article.
categories.rules: Sports betting adds Gambling rather than replacing Sports. Sports video and live broadcasts can add Video streaming and Live streaming. Competitive electronic games belong to Gaming; a dedicated esports competition service can also match Sports. Sports equipment stores primarily match Shopping & food unless sports coverage/services are substantial.

categories.name: Browsers
categories.definition: Domains or separable product hostnames dedicated to distributing, operating, or supporting web browsers, including alternative browser apps and browser-as-a-service browsing interfaces.
categories.yes: Dedicated browser download sites; web-browser product services; hosted remote-browser services.
categories.no: Every site opened in a browser; general web-development education; a search engine alone; a browser-extension store without a browser distribution service.
categories.rules: A browser is not automatically a bypass tool. Add VPNs, proxies & filter bypass only for a substantial integrated routing or circumvention service. Do not classify all products on a software vendor’s parent domain because it offers a browser. Shared vendor domains need a narrower match or review.

categories.name: Crypto & investing
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially supporting cryptocurrency, securities or investment trading, brokerage, investment accounts, market analysis, portfolio management, or investment-oriented communities.
categories.yes: Crypto exchanges; stock brokerages; portfolio services; dedicated investing analysis and trading communities.
categories.no: Everyday banking alone; household budgeting; tax filing; payment checkout; general economic education without an investing focus.
categories.rules: Legitimate regulated brokers qualify; the label does not mean fraud. Investing is distinct from Gambling unless wagering is separately offered. Financial news with a substantial investor focus can also match News. A bank’s inseparable substantial brokerage offering requires evidence and review, not an automatic label from its name.

categories.name: Cloud storage & file sharing
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially providing general-purpose online file storage, synchronization, transfer, collaborative file hosting, or user-controlled sharing and retrieval.
categories.yes: Cloud drives; large-file transfer services; general file-hosting services; collaborative file libraries.
categories.no: A normal site’s image server; a software update host; a chat app merely allowing attachments; a dedicated video-viewing service alone.
categories.rules: Do not assume uploaded content is pirated or malicious. Add those categories only on independent evidence. Multi-product suites need service-hostname targeting where possible. Shared object-storage parents and CDNs must not inherit the classification of one customer or stored object.

categories.name: Ads & trackers
categories.definition: Domains or dedicated hostnames primarily serving advertising, ad auctions, ad measurement, behavioral tracking, or third-party audience profiling, including analytics endpoints that materially support those functions.
categories.yes: Ad-delivery networks; tracking-pixel hosts; cross-site attribution services; analytics endpoints materially supporting behavioral tracking, cross-site identification, advertising measurement, or audience profiling.
categories.no: An ordinary publisher displaying ads; necessary account authentication; payment processing; security telemetry; privacy-preserving aggregate analytics; ordinary crash reporting; basic operational metrics without tracking or profiling; a generic CDN without tracking evidence.
categories.rules: Classify the network endpoint’s role, not every domain contacting it. Include analytics endpoints only when they materially support behavioral tracking, cross-site identification, advertising measurement, or audience profiling; privacy-preserving aggregate analytics, ordinary crash reporting, and basic operational metrics without tracking or profiling are excluded. First-party operational logging alone is excluded. Apply narrower hostname matches for mixed vendors; do not block a shared infrastructure parent because one tenant tracks users. Compatibility breakage is a deployment concern, not proof the category is malicious.

categories.name: Live streaming
categories.definition: Domains whose primary or substantial service broadcasts real-time or near-real-time audio or video to an audience, including user-hosted live channels, live TV, radio, and event broadcasts.
categories.yes: Twitch-style live channels; live TV services; internet radio; live-event viewing platforms.
categories.no: On-demand-only video libraries; private video meetings; one occasional webcast on a general site; real-time text chat without broadcasts.
categories.rules: Audience broadcasting distinguishes this from private calls. Substantial replay catalogs add Video streaming. Social interaction may add Social media or Messaging & chat apps if each is a substantial service. A platform offering both prerecorded and live viewing must not be forced into only one category.

categories.name: Remote access tools
categories.definition: Domains primarily or substantially providing software or services to view, control, administer, or support another computer or device remotely, including unattended access and remote desktop gateways.
categories.yes: Remote-desktop services; remote-support tools; dedicated remote administration services.
categories.no: Screen sharing without remote control as a core offering; file sync; ordinary video calls; generic cloud hosting; a mere login page.
categories.rules: Legitimate consent-based support qualifies by function, not maliciousness. Add Malware & phishing for covert or unauthorized surveillance only with separate evidence. VPNs transport traffic; remote access controls a device, so assign both only when both are substantial. Do not classify every enterprise site merely because employees can log in remotely.
